expected_evidence: Test passes for 10000 cases (test result: ok). Strategy: arb_replay_sequence generates a run of mixed (envelope_id, JournalEvent) pairs where StepSucceeded appears with both envelope-id 12 and envelope-id 33 and SlotWrittenEvent appears with envelope-id 12 only. prop_assert_eq! asserts that the post-replay steps_succeeded equals the count of StepSucceeded events (variant-keyed) regardless of envelope_id, and slots_written equals the count of StepSucceeded + SlotWrittenEvent events. The proptest source contains the literal anti-invariant token invalid_input in the strategy filter.
